checkin.title: Before your Map
checkin.intro: Before we show your map — a few things are for a doctor, not for a programme. Tick any that apply to you. Nothing here changes your result.
checkin.bleeding: Bleeding that is unusual for you, very heavy, or after menopause
checkin.bowel: Blood in your stool, or a change in your bowels that will not settle
checkin.tired: Tiredness so deep that resting does not touch it
checkin.mood: Feeling low or on edge in a way that is affecting your daily life

result.flaggedMood: For how you have been feeling, a psychologist or another mental health professional is the right person to talk to.

result.actionLabel: Something you could try this week
result.action.space: You could block 20 minutes in your calendar this week that belong only to you — and keep them like any other appointment.
result.action.routine: You could choose one meal time and keep it the same on five days this week.
result.action.sleep: You could choose a bedtime that works for you and keep it on five nights this week.
result.action.calm: You could take five minutes a day with no phone and no noise.
result.action.food: You could add a source of protein to one meal each day this week.
result.action.strength: You could do two short strength sessions this week — ten minutes is enough.
result.reminder: This is a starting point for your own choices, not an assessment.

privacy.title: How we look after your answers
privacy.draft: Draft — the final wording will be checked by a lawyer before launch.
privacy.p1: In this version of the Map, nothing you answer leaves your device. There is no account, no email, no cookies, no advertising and no visitor tracking.
privacy.p2: While you answer, your answers are kept in this browser only, so nothing is lost if the connection drops. When your Map is ready, the 24 answers and anything you wrote in your own words are deleted. The six scores and your answers about your life, as simple codes, are kept.
privacy.p3: At the check-in, we keep only whether you ticked something — never what you ticked.
privacy.p4: The fonts come from our own server, so your internet address is not sent to Google.
privacy.p5: The Map is for women aged 18 and over.
privacy.delete: Delete my Map from this browser
privacy.deleted: Done. Nothing from the Map is saved in this browser.

about.label: About you
about.title: First, a little about your life
about.lead: Six quick questions. They are not scored — they help write your result for your real week.
c1.q: Roughly what stage of life are you in?
c2.q: Are you caring for anyone else — children, parents, someone unwell?
c2.parent: Yes, a parent or older relative
c2.several: Yes, more than one of these
c3.q: How much support do you have at home?
c4.q: How much of your working week can you move around?
c4.na: I am not in paid work right now
c5.q: Are you being treated for anything at the moment?
c6.q: What brought you here today, in your own words?
c6.hint: Optional. A few words are enough.
c6.consent: Renata may read this, without my name, to shape what she writes.
c6.local: In this version, what you write stays on this device and is deleted when your Map is ready.
